baseline_models.focus_anchor: The fronted phrase 'to your Lord' governs al-mustaqarr; rabbika and mustaqarr are the two lexical anchors.
baseline_models.mechanism: Lordship and ownership combine with fixed settling: every trajectory terminates in a state or place held under the Lord's authority.

activation_trace.role: Lordship, ownership, and authority supply the governing possessor of the endpoint.
Settling and remaining fixed supply the terminal state or place.

changed_reading.before: A bare statement that there will be a destination that day.
changed_reading.after: That day's endpoint is a fixed condition whose location and authority belong to the Lord.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Rabbika can activate nurture and completion, while al-mustaqarr names achieved fixity.
baseline_models.mechanism: Stage-by-stage care and completion lead into settlement, so the endpoint can be the completion of a managed process rather than an arbitrary stop.

activation_trace.role: Repair, nurture, administration, and completion supply the process that brings the creature to completion.
Fixed settlement supplies the completed state reached by that process.

changed_reading.before: Settlement is merely where motion stops.
changed_reading.after: Settlement is where the Lord brings a sustained creature-forming process to completed fixity.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Al-mustaqarr remains anchored in q-r-r, whose inventory includes making a truth fixed through acknowledgment.
baseline_models.mechanism: Under sovereign lordship, settlement can have a forensic edge: a matter ceases to be contestable because its truth is established and acknowledged.

activation_trace.role: Authority supplies the forum in which a matter becomes conclusive.
Affirming and acknowledging supply a forensic mode of making truth settled.

changed_reading.before: Al-mustaqarr denotes only a destination or resting state.
changed_reading.after: It may also resonate as the conclusive fixing and acknowledgment of the case before the Lord.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening resurrection frame moves from rising, through gathering dispersed bones, to the capacity for exact bodily completion. This makes the settled subject in 75:12 materially reconstituted rather than merely abstract.

activation_trace.role: Nurture and completion anchor the endpoint as the completion of a formative process.
Fixed settlement supplies the terminal condition of the reassembled subject.
Resurrection and the rising of the Hour establish the bodily-after-death frame.
Gathering dispersed parts into one whole supplies material reassembly.
Effective capacity supplies the power that carries reassembly into actuality.
Whole-form straightness and completion supply the precision of restored embodiment.

structural_cues: 75:1-4 places resurrection, bone gathering, and fingertip-level restoration before the declaration of settlement in 75:12.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies resurrection, gathering, capacity, and completed form; I infer that the one settled before the Lord is bodily reconstituted, while an abstract legal endpoint remains a live alternative.

changed_reading.before: The endpoint could be an abstract postmortem station detached from embodiment.
changed_reading.after: The Lord's settlement receives the same person after exact material reassembly, down to the body's fine limits.

context_deltas.mechanism: Transfixed sight, sinking or loss, and the gathering of normally separate luminaries remove the ordinary visual and cosmic coordinates by which a refuge could be located. The Lord's settlement becomes the sole remaining frame of fixity.

activation_trace.role: Remaining fixed anchors the contrast with a cosmos whose stable markers fail.
The eye's transfixed stare supplies perceptual disorientation.
Sinking into the earth supplies the loss of an apparently stable support.
Gathering what was separate collapses the normal distinction between the two luminaries.

structural_cues: 75:7-9 forms a three-step collapse of sight, moon, and the sun-moon ordering immediately before the search for escape.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies perceptual shock, sinking, and cosmic gathering; I infer that these cancel ordinary coordinates so that 75:12 names a non-cosmic fixity, though the sequence can also remain a literal prelude without this spatial implication.

changed_reading.before: Al-mustaqarr might be one stable location among other locations.
changed_reading.after: It is the fixity that remains when familiar supports and celestial coordinates no longer organize space.

context_deltas.mechanism: The question about flight opens an escape trajectory, the categorical denial of refuge closes every alternate endpoint, and the fronted 'to your Lord' directs that blocked motion into al-mustaqarr.

activation_trace.role: Sovereign ownership supplies the authority from which no rival shelter can remove the person.
Fixed settlement supplies the terminus that replaces attempted flight.
Flight and escape supply the outward motion that seeks another terminus.
Refuge supplies the alternative endpoint explicitly denied by the sequence.

structural_cues: 75:10 asks where flight is possible, 75:11 answers that no refuge exists, and 75:12 supplies the only directional complement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attempted escape, denied refuge, and fixed settlement; I infer that blocking every alternative directs the person to the Lord, while 'the decision belongs to your Lord' remains a non-spatial alternative.

changed_reading.before: The verse calmly identifies a final destination.
changed_reading.after: The verse closes an attempted escape: every evasive line is forced into the Lord's inescapable jurisdiction and fixed endpoint.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately after the settlement, acts sent ahead and left behind are reported; the self remains inwardly perceptive while excuses attempt to screen the case. This activates q-r-r as conclusive acknowledgment, not only location.

activation_trace.role: Lordship supplies the authority before which the record is settled.
Affirmation and acknowledgment supply the fixing of an otherwise contested record.
A report brought and delivered supplies disclosure of the record.
Advancing something ahead supplies one temporal side of the person's acts.
Deferring something to a later time supplies the complementary remainder of the record.
Insight of the heart supplies the self's unavoidable inward witness.
Excuses imaged as curtains supply attempted concealment that cannot erase inward sight.

structural_cues: 75:13-15 follows al-mustaqarr with a report of the total temporal record, self-witness, and a concessive 'even if' introducing excuses.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies disclosure, both temporal directions of action, inner sight, and screening excuses; I infer that these force the case into acknowledgment, while a purely locative settlement can coexist.

changed_reading.before: The settlement is principally where the person arrives.
changed_reading.after: It is also where the person's whole record becomes fixed and self-acknowledging despite defensive screens.

context_deltas.mechanism: The recitation interlude blocks hasty motion and assigns gathering and clarification to the divine speaker. It supplies a procedural analogue for al-mustaqarr: stable completion is produced by controlled gathering and disclosure, not by human acceleration.

activation_trace.role: Administration and completion anchor settlement as a process governed to completion.
Fixity supplies the stable result of that governed process.
Haste and premature advancement supply the human timing explicitly restrained.
Gathering dispersed material into one whole supplies divinely managed integration.
Disclosure of meaning by speech or sign supplies the clarification that completes gathering.

structural_cues: 75:16-19 repeats divine responsibility: restraint of haste, then 'upon Us' for gathering and clarification.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies blocked haste and divinely assumed gathering and explanation; I infer an analogous process-control over final settlement, while the live alternative is that the interlude concerns recitation alone.

changed_reading.before: The verse names only the final result.
changed_reading.after: Its fixity can be heard as the outcome of a Lord-governed sequence of gathering and disclosure that human haste cannot control.

context_deltas.mechanism: Love is oriented toward the immediate while the later is abandoned; afterward faces become directional and look toward their Lord. The repeated 'to her Lord' sharpens 75:12 from bare arrival into a repaired orientation of desire, face, and attention.

activation_trace.role: Settlement anchors the eventual stability of a previously misdirected orientation.
Immediate advancement supplies the temporal object toward which desire is misdirected.
What comes after supplies the neglected temporal horizon.
Face as direction supplies the reorientation of the whole person.
The repeated Lord-anchor makes the directional echo with 75:12 explicit.
Directed sight or insight supplies sustained attention toward the Lord.

structural_cues: The immediate/later opposition in 75:20-21 is followed by the directional phrase 'to her Lord' in 75:23, echoing 'to your Lord' in 75:12.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies temporal preference and a repeated Lord-directed face and gaze; I infer that final settling repairs orientation, while the face passage may instead describe one outcome without defining al-mustaqarr.

changed_reading.before: Settlement is compulsory arrival at an external endpoint.
changed_reading.after: For one live branch, it is also the stabilization of the person's attention toward the Lord after attachment to the immediate.

context_deltas.mechanism: The death sequence reaches a bodily limit, recognizes separation, and wraps limb with limb; it then repeats the exact frame 'to your Lord that day' but replaces al-mustaqarr with al-masaq. Settlement is thereby interpreted through compelled conveyance.

activation_trace.role: Fixed settlement supplies the endpoint whose mode of arrival is clarified by the later parallel.
Arrival at a limit supplies the terminal bodily threshold.
Separation and distinction supply the recognized rupture of death.
Wrapping one thing around another supplies the body's constricted final posture.
The repeated Lord-anchor identifies the same sovereign destination as 75:12.
Driving and herding supply the compelled motion by which the endpoint is reached.

structural_cues: 75:30 repeats 'to your Lord that day' from 75:12 word for word and substitutes al-masaq for al-mustaqarr.
The branchless collarbone phrase in 75:26 marks the bodily threshold but is used only as a structural cue.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bodily limit, separation, wrapping, the repeated frame, and driving; I infer that al-masaq explains the kinetic path into al-mustaqarr, though the two nominals may remain parallel statements rather than one defining the other.

changed_reading.before: Al-mustaqarr sounds like a repose one simply occupies.
changed_reading.after: It is the terminal fixity into which the dying person is driven after bodily motion and alternatives close down.

context_deltas.mechanism: Turning away is followed by a self-directed trip 'to his people' in a swaggering posture. That chosen social destination contrasts with the repeated compelled direction to the Lord, making familiar belonging a provisional pseudo-settlement.

activation_trace.role: Lordship anchors the ultimate relation of belonging and authority.
Fixed settlement supplies the true endpoint against which the household trip is measured.
Turning away supplies rejection of the Lord-directed orientation.
Going away supplies a chosen movement that mimics but cannot replace the final conveyance.
Kinship and belonging supply the attractive social home treated as an endpoint.
Swaggering bodily extension supplies the illusion of autonomous control over the journey.

structural_cues: The compulsory 'to your Lord' of 75:30 is followed by the voluntary 'to his people' of 75:33, with opposite postures of conveyance and swagger.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies turning away, chosen departure, kin-belonging, and swagger; I infer that the household is staged as a false endpoint, while the scene can alternatively function only as a portrait of arrogance.

changed_reading.before: The Lord's settlement competes only with spatial escape routes.
changed_reading.after: It also relativizes the social home in which the denier feels secure: familiar belonging is temporary, while the Lord is the true endpoint.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing question denies that the human is left as-is, recalls creation and proportioning, and asks about effective power to restore life after its loss. This completes the nurturing model: al-mustaqarr is the intended finish of continuous governance, not abandonment.

activation_trace.role: Nurture, administration, and completion anchor a process that is not abandoned midway.
Fixed settlement supplies the intended completion of that process.
Leaving something in its present condition supplies the abandonment explicitly questioned.
Bringing creation into existence supplies the first act of purposeful formation.
Completion and straightness of form supply purposeful finishing rather than neglect.
Effective capacity supplies the ability to complete return as well as first formation.
Living animation supplies the restored condition toward which power acts.
Loss of force and life supplies the condition that does not terminate divine governance.

structural_cues: 75:36 asks whether the human will be left without directed consequence; 75:37-40 answers through a creation sequence ending in the power to revive the dead.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies questioned abandonment, initial making, completed form, effective power, life, and death; I infer continuity from first formation to final settlement, while a narrower reading may take the close only as proof of resurrection.

changed_reading.before: The final settlement could look like a disconnected terminal decree.
changed_reading.after: It is the intended completion of the same lordly governance that formed, proportioned, and can reanimate the person rather than leave that person unfinished.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates q-r-r's reproductive-fluid and established-pregnancy branch rather than the ordinary locative branch. It remains anchored in al-mustaqarr and is made materially relevant by the sperm-to-attached-stage sequence in 75:37-38; downstream prose should present it only as an analogical echo, never as the direct lexical gloss of al-mustaqarr.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Al-mustaqarr carries root q-r-r, and its B013 branch explicitly images reproductive fluid settling in the womb and an established pregnancy; rabbika supplies nurturing completion.

activation_trace.role: Stage-by-stage nurture and completion supply continuity between first formation and final settling.
Fluid settling in the womb and established pregnancy supply the unusual material image of fixity.
Generative fluid from which form is determined supplies the first material state.
Pregnancy becoming attached and fixed in the womb supplies the transition into embodied stability.
Creative bringing-into-being supplies the completed embodiment that follows fixation.

changed_reading.before: Final settlement and embryonic formation are unrelated endpoints.
changed_reading.after: The final mustaqarr faintly mirrors the creature's first hidden settling into gestation: both are fixities brought to completion under the Lord.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because q-r-r B005 concerns pouring speech into an ear, not the default sense of mustaqarr. It remains focus-root anchored and the tongue-recitation-clarification interlude gives the auditory mechanism local support; downstream prose should call it a resonance of an imparted verdict becoming fixed, not translate al-mustaqarr as speech or hearing.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Al-mustaqarr anchors the activation in q-r-r, whose B005 branch includes speech poured into an ear.

activation_trace.role: Speech poured into an ear supplies an auditory path by which a declaration can become settled.
The tongue as organ of speech supplies the controlled human side of utterance.
Recitation and reading supply the delivered verbal material.
Meaning disclosed through speech or sign supplies the verdict's intelligibility.

changed_reading.before: Settlement is wholly spatial or stative.
changed_reading.after: An exploratory auditory layer hears it as the Lord's disclosed determination entering awareness and becoming impossible to dislodge.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it joins the rare covenant branch of r-b-b to q-r-r's acknowledgment branch. Both roots occur in the focus and the surah opens with apportioned oath language, so the mechanism remains anchored; downstream prose should qualify it as a juridical-covenantal overtone rather than identifying rabb or mustaqarr with a pact.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Rabbika activates the r-b-b covenant branch and al-mustaqarr activates the q-r-r acknowledgment branch within the focus clause itself.

activation_trace.role: A binding covenant or pact supplies a relational obligation held under the Lord.
Acknowledgment and ratification supply the act by which that obligation becomes conclusive.
An oath apportioned upon its parties supplies the opening binding-speech frame.

changed_reading.before: The endpoint is a destination imposed without relational history.
changed_reading.after: It may carry a covenantal overtone: before the Lord, the binding claim is finally ratified and acknowledged.

strongest_changes: The no-flight and no-refuge sequence turns a neutral destination into the inescapable closure of evasive motion.
The exact 75:30 repetition of 'to your Lord that day' with al-masaq makes compelled driving the kinetic path into al-mustaqarr.
The opening and closing creation sequences make the settled subject embodied, reassembled, and continuously governed rather than abstract or abandoned.
The report, self-insight, and failed excuses activate settlement as the conclusive fixing and acknowledgment of the person's record.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah package exposes two unusually productive internal parallels: al-mustaqarr is paired syntactically with al-masaq, and final fixity is bracketed by exact bodily formation. The revelation interlude also supplies a smaller process model of restrained haste, gathering, and clarification, while the gestational q-r-r branch preserves a contained material outlier.
remaining_uncertainties: Al-mustaqarr can still foreground place, state, final decision, or a blend of these without the packet forcing one choice.
The forensic acknowledgment reading is well activated by 75:13-15 but remains a branch resonance rather than a necessary gloss of the noun.
The recitation-process, gestational, auditory, and covenantal models are analogical activations and should not displace the stronger sovereign and compelled-endpoint readings.
